title: perf: Portfolio Pages test job redraws the same ~2,500 share cards in every test build
problem: The Portfolio Pages 'test' job is the largest single consumer of the runner pool and the slowest check most venture PRs wait on. build.test.mjs runs five buildSite calls in one process (tests in a file run serially), and custom-domain.test.mjs one more; each call spends most of its time in addShareCards/renderCards drawing card PNGs whose inputs have not changed.
evidence: ci_profile.py 2026-10-24: Portfolio Pages 230.7 of 750 job-minutes, heaviest step 'Test the site builder' 122.2 minutes over 75 jobs
a two-venture fixture build takes 36.9s locally, of which addShareCards 27.4s (phase timestamps in a throwaway copy of build.mjs); the build always includes ~1,228 research and writing pages
renderCard: 62.7 ms per card on one thread (10-run mean)
slowest tests in the full suite: shared build 115.6s, kill-switch build 80.1s, identical-cache build 75.4s, custom-domain build 65.6s, /compare/ and /guides/ fixture builds 31s each
change: Cache card PNGs by content so repeat builds do not redraw them. Shipped in PR #10208 (platform/pages/share.mjs renderCards): an in-process map keyed by the card options, which is what makes the test suite's repeat builds cheap, plus an optional disk cache (PAGES_CARD_CACHE) keyed by the options and the files a card's pixels depend on, which the deploy workflow can carry between builds. Measurements and the in-memory design: docs/history/pages-test-perf-2026-10-24.md.
metric: wall time of node --test build.test.mjs locally, and the 'Test the site builder' step in CI
baseline: node --test build.test.mjs 460s wall locally (4 cores, 2026-10-24); CI 'Test the site builder' 122.2 job-minutes over 75 jobs in 80 minutes
